abilities.name: Terror Tactics
abilities.text: When your Stealth Score is reduced to 0 or you Ambush a Threat, you can choose for all enemies who can see or hear you to take a Terror Test, with a DN equal to 1 + Rank. At Rank 1, that is DN 2.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Lightning Assault
abilities.text: Favouring fast-attack bikes to achieve their famed agile strikes, White Scars are proficient at attacking at speeds that would be otherwise unwieldy. You may reroll Double Rank dice once each time you make a Pilot (A) Test. You triple your Speed when you Charge (p.188).

abilities.name: Ritual Scarring (Tradition)
abilities.text: Inductees to the chapter mark the flesh of their faces deeply with their blades. You suffer a +1 DN penalty to any Fellowship-based Test made against any target that could be frightened of your appearance.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Killer Instinct (+1 Max Wounds); Accomplishment Crusader (+1 Determination); Goal Advancement (+1 Influence). Determination is 6 (T 5 + 1).

talents.name: Eliminator
talents.text: When you have a Stealth Score (p.181) and you attack an enemy that is unaware of you, you may add your Stealth Score as ED, in addition to the bonuses received from a Surprise Attack (p.182). Any decrease to your Stealth Score is resolved after the attack.

talents.name: Dual Wield
talents.text: When you wield one weapon in each hand the DN penalty for using the Multi-Attack option is reduced by 2. Each weapon must have the Pistol Trait or be a one-handed melee weapon. You may also use a different weapon you are wielding for each of your Multi-Attacks, rolling damage separately for each weapon.

talents.name: Raiding Master
talents.text: You gain +(Rank) dice to all Tests to plan and execute a raid or ambush. You also gain the same bonus to Tests to detect or prevent enemies from raiding or ambushing you and your allies.

gear: Grav-Chute (Core p.237): hover or control a fall for up to one hour; recharge the solar battery by leaving it in sunlight for one hour
Grapnel Launcher (FSPG p.126): fire it as a Combat Action into any surface within 30 m, default DN 3; if it latches on, retract it to pull yourself up to that surface as a Free Action
Shock Grenade (FSPG p.124): deals Shock instead of Wounds; a target that suffers any Shock is also Blinded and Vulnerable
Hellfire Bolt rounds (+3 ED against organic targets, +2 ED against inorganic, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: A Chogorian hunter who ties a knot for every xenos leader he beheads. He jokes at the worst moments and is never where the enemy last saw him.

objectives.text: Chapter: take the head of the xenos leader.
Secret: be first into every fight, unseen.
